We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer. You will own Kubernetes clusters on AWS,
write infrastructure as code with Terraform, and build observability with Prometheus and Grafana.
Experience with Golang or Python is required. Knowledge of Kafka and PostgreSQL is a plus.
You will join an on-call rotation and run incident response and postmortems.
Dr. Patel from our hiring panel will interview you. We value high availability design.
